products.name: Offshore Contract Drilling Services
products.description: Provision of offshore drilling rigs (including drillships, semisubmersibles, and jackup rigs) and rig crews to oil and gas companies on a day rate contract basis. Services are delivered through physical deployment and operation of rigs, requiring specialized equipment, skilled labor, and compliance with industry regulations.

products.name: Rig Mobilization, Demobilization, and Upgrade Services
products.description: Provision of services related to moving drilling rigs to and from drilling sites and performing capital upgrades, for which customers may pay lump-sum fees or similar compensation. These services involve logistical planning, transportation, and technical enhancements to rigs.

products.name: Management Services for Third-Party Rigs
products.description: Management of drilling rigs owned by third parties, including operational oversight and support. This service is delivered through in-person management and technical expertise, leveraging Valaris' operational capabilities for external rig owners.

products.name: Ancillary Offshore Services (Well Workovers, Interventions, Plug and Abandonment, Decommissioning, Carbon Capture Projects)
products.description: Provision of additional offshore services such as well workovers, interventions, plug and abandonment, decommissioning, and support for carbon capture and sequestration projects, utilizing existing rig assets and specialized crews. These services are delivered on-site and require technical expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Credit Ratings
products.description: Moody's provides credit ratings for a wide range of debt obligations, programs, facilities, and the entities that issue such obligations globally. This service is delivered through a regulated process involving experienced analysts and proprietary methodologies, and is a primary revenue driver for the company.

products.name: Fixed Income and Economic Research
products.description: Moody's offers fixed income and economic research, including analysis and insights on financial stability, creditworthiness, and global debt markets. This research is delivered digitally and supports decision-making for investors, issuers, and other market participants.

products.name: Risk and Compliance Data Solutions
products.description: Moody's provides curated data and analytics, including the world’s largest database on companies and credit, to support risk identification, measurement, monitoring, and compliance workflows. These solutions are delivered via cloud-based platforms and APIs, integrating proprietary data and analytics into customer workflows.

products.name: Enterprise Risk Management Software
products.description: Moody's delivers AI-enabled, cloud-based workflow tools and enterprise risk management software for banking, insurance, and KYC (Know Your Customer) use cases. These digital solutions embed Moody’s data and analytics into mission-critical customer processes.

products.name: Financial Instruments Pricing Services
products.description: Moody's provides pricing services for financial instruments, primarily in the Asia-Pacific region, supporting valuation and risk assessment needs for financial institutions. This service is delivered digitally and is ancillary to the core ratings business.

products.name: Sustainability and Climate Risk Assessment Services
products.description: Moody's offers sustainability and climate risk assessment services, including Net Zero Assessment frameworks and climate insights, to help organizations evaluate and report on sustainability-related risks. These services are delivered through proprietary models and digital platforms.

products.name: Household Products
products.description: Includes kitchen appliances, food and home storage, fresh preserving, vacuum sealing, gourmet cookware, bakeware, cutlery, and home fragrance products. These are physically manufactured goods distributed through retail and direct-to-consumer channels.

products.name: Commercial Cleaning and Maintenance Solutions
products.description: Commercial cleaning and maintenance products, closet and garage organization, hygiene systems, and material handling solutions, primarily sold to commercial customers. These are manufactured physical goods distributed through commercial channels.

products.name: Writing Instruments and Art Products
products.description: Writing instruments (markers, highlighters, pens, pencils), art products, and activity-based products, designed and manufactured for consumers and educational markets. Delivered as physical goods through retail and e-commerce.

products.name: Labeling Solutions
products.description: Labeling devices and solutions, including digital and manual label makers, primarily for office and home use. Manufactured and distributed through retail and e-commerce.

products.name: Baby Gear and Infant Care Products
products.description: Baby gear and infant care products, including strollers, car seats, and feeding products, manufactured and distributed to consumers via retail and e-commerce.

products.name: Active Lifestyle and Outdoor Products
products.description: Products for outdoor and recreational activities, including technical apparel and on-the-go beverageware. These are manufactured goods sold through retail, specialty, and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Therapeutic Antibodies for Neurodegenerative and Amyloid Diseases
products.description: Development and commercialization of monoclonal antibody therapies targeting misfolded proteins implicated in neurodegenerative and rare peripheral amyloid diseases, including Parkinson’s disease (prasinezumab), ATTR amyloidosis (coramitug), Alzheimer’s disease (BMS-986446, PRX012), and other related conditions. These products are biologics manufactured through advanced antibody engineering and delivered via intravenous or subcutaneous administration, often in partnership with large pharmaceutical companies.

products.name: CYTOPE® Technology-Enabled Intracellular Therapeutics
products.description: Development and licensing of proprietary CYTOPE® technology, which enables precise targeting of intracellular disease pathways in the brain and periphery through endosomal uptake and escape mechanisms. This platform is used to create novel therapeutics for previously undruggable intracellular targets, such as TDP-43 in ALS, and is offered through research collaborations and licensing to pharmaceutical partners.

products.name: Alzheimer’s Disease Vaccine (PRX123)
products.description: Development of a dual Aβ-tau vaccine (PRX123) for the potential prevention and treatment of Alzheimer’s disease. This product is a biologic vaccine designed to generate immune responses against both amyloid beta and tau proteins, delivered via immunization and currently in early clinical development.

products.name: Factory-Built Homes (Manufactured and Modular Homes)
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells a broad range of factory-built homes, including manufactured and modular homes for single-family and multi-family markets, produced in indoor assembly-line facilities and delivered to customers via a network of independent and company-owned retail centers.

products.name: Park Model RVs and Cabins
products.description: Produces park model recreational vehicles (RVs) and cabins, built in factory settings for use in resorts, campgrounds, and recreational or backyard living, distributed through retail centers and direct sales.

products.name: Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs)
products.description: Designs and manufactures accessory dwelling units (ADUs) for backyard or recreational living, built in factories and delivered to customers through retail and builder/developer channels.

products.name: Modular Buildings for Single and Multi-Family Markets
products.description: Produces modular buildings for single-family and multi-family applications, including townhomes, apartments, duplexes, and triplexes, using factory-based construction and delivered to builder/developer customers.

products.name: Retail Sales of Factory-Built Homes
products.description: Operates company-owned retail sales centers under various brands, offering direct-to-consumer sales of manufactured and modular homes, park model RVs, and ADUs, including model home displays and customization options.

products.name: Construction and Installation Services for Factory-Built Homes
products.description: Provides construction services for the installation and set-up of factory-built homes at customer sites, including foundation placement, joining of home sections, and finishing work, delivered by employee crews or third-party contractors.

products.name: Transportation and Logistics Services for Manufactured Homes and RVs
products.description: Operates Star Fleet Trucking, providing specialized transportation and logistics services for manufactured homes and recreational vehicles from manufacturing facilities to retailers and home sites, coordinated through dispatch terminals.

products.name: Manufactured Housing Financing Products
products.description: Offers tailored dealer floor plan and consumer retail financing products for manufactured housing through Champion Financing, a joint venture, facilitating both inventory and consumer loans to support home purchases.

products.name: Social Media Management Platform
products.description: A centralized, AI-powered software platform that enables organizations to manage, schedule, publish, and analyze social media content across multiple networks. Delivered as a cloud-based SaaS solution, it integrates with major social platforms and is licensed on a per-user subscription basis.

products.name: Social Listening and Business Intelligence
products.description: A suite of tools within the platform that aggregates, analyzes, and visualizes real-time and historical social data to provide actionable insights, market research, competitive benchmarking, and consumer trend analysis. Delivered digitally via the platform and available as a premium module.

products.name: Reporting and Analytics
products.description: Comprehensive reporting and analytics capabilities that measure social media performance, campaign effectiveness, customer service metrics, and ROI, with customizable reports and API integration for business intelligence tools. Delivered digitally as part of the platform and as premium modules.

products.name: Social Customer Care
products.description: AI-driven tools for managing customer interactions, inquiries, and support cases across social channels, including unified inbox, case management, automation, and chatbot creation. Delivered digitally as part of the platform and designed for enterprise-scale customer service.

products.name: Publishing and Scheduling
products.description: Tools for planning, creating, scheduling, and publishing social media content across multiple networks, with workflow automation, approval processes, and content libraries. Delivered digitally within the platform.

products.name: Reputation and Review Management
products.description: Solutions for monitoring, managing, and responding to brand reputation and customer reviews across social media and major review platforms, helping brands address issues and build trust. Delivered digitally as part of the platform.

products.name: Influencer Marketing Platform
products.description: A digital platform for managing end-to-end influencer marketing campaigns, including influencer discovery, campaign management, and performance analytics, powered by proprietary algorithms. Delivered as a premium module integrated with the core platform.

products.name: Employee Advocacy Solution
products.description: A digital solution enabling organizations to empower employees to share approved content and act as brand advocates on social media, with tools for content distribution, newsletter creation, and performance tracking. Delivered as a premium module integrated with the platform.

products.name: Predictive Media Intelligence (NewsWhip)
products.description: A real-time, AI-powered media monitoring and predictive analytics solution that tracks news and social trends, detects emerging narratives, and provides alerts and insights for crisis management and reputation protection. Delivered digitally, including API access for integration with workflows.

products.name: Social Commerce Integration
products.description: Tools that integrate e-commerce platforms with social media, enabling brands to link product catalogs, manage SKU availability, and drive sales directly through social channels. Delivered digitally as part of the platform.

products.name: Micro-Invasive Glaucoma Surgery (MIGS) Devices
products.description: Physically manufactured, micro-scale surgical devices (iStent family and PRESERFLO MicroShunt) implanted in the eye to restore natural aqueous humor outflow and reduce intraocular pressure in glaucoma patients. Delivered via minimally invasive surgical procedures, often during cataract surgery.

products.name: Sustained-Release Intracameral Glaucoma Pharmaceuticals
products.description: Drug-device combination implants (iDose TR) physically manufactured and implanted inside the eye to continuously deliver proprietary glaucoma medication over extended periods, reducing intraocular pressure and addressing patient compliance issues. Delivered via in-office or surgical procedures.

products.name: Bio-Activated Corneal Pharmaceuticals and Cross-Linking Systems
products.description: Proprietary drug formulations (Photrexa, Epioxa) bio-activated by UVA light systems (KXL, iLink) to induce corneal collagen cross-linking, strengthening and reshaping the cornea for treatment of keratoconus and corneal ectasia. Requires both pharmaceutical manufacturing and regulated device delivery systems.

products.name: Transdermal Ophthalmic Pharmaceuticals
products.description: Cream-based pharmaceutical formulations (iLution platform) applied to the eyelid for dropless, transdermal delivery of active compounds to treat anterior segment eye disorders such as Demodex blepharitis and myopia. Manufactured as topical drugs and delivered by patient or clinician application.

products.name: Sustained-Release Intravitreal Retinal Pharmaceuticals
products.description: Bio-erodible, micro-invasive implants (Retinal XR platform) designed for sustained release of pharmaceuticals (e.g., triamcinolone acetonide SR, multi-kinase inhibitor SR, anti-VEGF SR) to treat retinal diseases such as AMD, DME, and RVO. Manufactured as drug-device combinations and delivered via intravitreal injection.

products.name: Adjunct Ophthalmic Pharmaceuticals for Glaucoma Surgery
products.description: FDA-approved ophthalmic formulation of mitomycin-C (Mitosol) used as an adjunct during late-stage glaucoma filtration procedures. Manufactured as a pharmaceutical and delivered by clinicians during surgery.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of commercial loans including lines of credit, equipment financing, and commercial real estate loans to small and medium-sized businesses. These loans are originated and serviced through in-person banking relationships and require significant underwriting, collateral evaluation, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offers a full suite of deposit products to personal and business customers, including checking, savings, money market, and certificate of deposit accounts. These are delivered through physical branches and digital channels, and are a primary funding source for the bank.

products.name: Real Estate Construction and Land Development Lending
products.description: Originates loans for residential, commercial, and multifamily construction projects, as well as land development. These loans are provided to builders and developers, requiring physical inspections, strict underwriting, and ongoing project monitoring.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Loans
products.description: Provides loans secured by single-family residences, primarily owner-occupied, with terms typically ranging from 15 to 30 years. While new originations ceased in January 2024, the bank continues to hold and may acquire pools of such loans.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers secured and unsecured consumer loans and lines of credit to individuals. These are originated through branch networks and require standard credit underwriting and compliance with consumer lending regulations.

products.name: Wealth Management and Investment Advisory Services
products.description: Provides investment advice and wealth management services to customers through a dedicated department. Services are delivered by financial advisors and include objective advice on investment strategies and portfolio management.

products.name: Cash Management and Digital Banking Services
products.description: Delivers technology-based banking products such as online personal financial management, business cash management, and remote deposit services. These are digital-only offerings that support both retail and business customers.

products.name: aiWARE Platform and Industry Applications
products.description: A modular, AI-powered software-as-a-service platform that orchestrates machine learning models and applications to analyze, manage, and extract insights from structured and unstructured data for commercial and public sector customers. Delivered via cloud, on-premises, or hybrid environments, it enables rapid deployment of industry-specific AI applications and workflows.

products.name: Digital Content Management Solutions
products.description: Cloud-native, AI-enabled media management solutions that allow rights holders and enterprises to ingest, organize, manage, and provide secure, permission-based access to digital content, with intelligent search, discovery, and reporting tools. Delivered as SaaS for media, entertainment, and corporate customers.

products.name: Content Licensing Services
products.description: Managed services for digital content licensing, where Veritone manages and licenses content on behalf of rights holders to end users in film, television, sports, and advertising, utilizing AI to enhance searchability and efficiency. Delivered via web portals and direct arrangements.

products.name: Talent Acquisition Solutions
products.description: Cloud-native software and programmatic advertising platform for employers to attract, manage, and optimize hiring processes, integrated with applicant tracking systems and job boards, leveraging AI for predictive analytics and campaign optimization. Delivered as SaaS.

products.name: Artificial Intelligence Professional Services
products.description: Consulting and implementation services to help customers assess data readiness, formulate AI strategies, modernize data infrastructure, develop custom AI solutions, and provide AI education. Delivered through professional services engagements.

products.name: Live Event Services
products.description: Onsite support for production teams at major live events, ingesting live content, applying AI-driven cognition and metadata, and making content immediately accessible for highlights, publication, and programming. Delivered as managed services at event locations.

products.name: Representation Services for Influencers
products.description: Management and representation services for social media influencers, including content creation and custom marketing campaign development for brand partners and agencies. Delivered as managed services to influencers and brands.

products.name: VeriAds Network Advertising Solutions
products.description: Advertising network services enabling broadcasters, podcasters, and influencers to generate incremental revenue from premium advertisers through unique ad units, including run-of-schedule and on-demand live read ads, managed and verified using AI analytics. Delivered as managed network services.

products.name: Public Sector Digital Evidence Management and Investigation Solutions
products.description: AI-powered software suite for government, law enforcement, and legal customers to ingest, manage, analyze, search, redact, and track digital evidence (audio, video, documents), including applications for investigation, identification, eDiscovery, redaction, and compliance. Delivered as SaaS or on-premises solutions.

products.name: Generative AI Solutions
products.description: AI-powered generative content creation tools and services, enabling organizations to leverage and create domain-specific large language models and knowledge graphs for tasks such as conversation simulation, multilingual content production, and data summarization. Delivered natively in aiWARE, via API, and through Automate Studio.

products.name: Industrial Abrasives and Finishing Products
products.description: Manufactured abrasives and finishing solutions for metalworking and industrial applications, delivered through direct sales and distribution channels.

products.name: Industrial Adhesives, Tapes, and Specialty Materials
products.description: Manufactured adhesives, tapes, and specialty materials for industrial, construction, and OEM applications, distributed globally through various channels.

products.name: Personal Safety Products
products.description: Manufactured respiratory, hearing, eye, and fall protection solutions for workplace and personal safety, sold to industrial and commercial customers.

products.name: Electrical Products and Materials
products.description: Manufactured electrical infrastructure products, including cable accessories, insulation tapes, and materials for construction, maintenance, and OEMs, distributed globally.

products.name: Roofing Granules and Advanced Materials
products.description: Manufactured mineral granules for shingles and advanced ceramic solutions, supplied to building materials and industrial markets.

products.name: Automotive and Aerospace Solutions
products.description: Attachment, bonding, films, sound and temperature management, and specialty materials for automotive and aerospace manufacturers, delivered through OEM and aftermarket channels.

products.name: Commercial Graphics and Reflective Signage
products.description: Manufactured graphic films and reflective materials for advertising, fleet signage, and transportation safety, distributed to commercial and government customers.

products.name: Display and Electronics Materials
products.description: Manufactured display enhancement films, optically clear adhesives, and electronic assembly solutions for electronics manufacturers and data centers.

products.name: Semiconductor and Electronic Interconnect Solutions
products.description: Manufactured chip packaging, interconnection solutions, and semiconductor production materials for electronics and semiconductor industries.

products.name: Home Cleaning and Care Products
products.description: Manufactured cleaning products, air quality solutions, and home care accessories for consumers, distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Home Improvement and DIY Products
products.description: Manufactured abrasives, paint accessories, picture hanging solutions, and safety products for home improvement and DIY consumers, sold through retail channels.

products.name: Stationery and Office Products
products.description: Manufactured tapes, sticky notes, and related office supplies for consumers and businesses, distributed globally through retail and commercial channels.

products.name: Automotive Appearance and Care Products
products.description: Manufactured car wash, cleaning, and appearance products for consumer and professional automotive markets, distributed through retail and specialty channels.

products.name: Consumer Health Care Products
products.description: Manufactured bandages, tapes, braces, supports, and related health care products for consumer use, distributed through retail and pharmacy channels.

products.name: Jet Engine and Aircraft Component Replacement Parts
products.description: FAA-approved, factory-new and overhauled jet engine and aircraft component replacement parts manufactured using proprietary technology and advanced engineering, sold to commercial airlines, repair facilities, OEMs, and government agencies.

products.name: Repair and Overhaul Services for Aircraft Components and Avionics
products.description: Repair, refurbishment, and overhaul of jet engine and aircraft component parts, avionics, instruments, composites, and flight surfaces, requiring advanced technology and certified facilities, provided to commercial airlines, military, and repair companies.

products.name: Distribution and Integration of Aircraft and Military Parts
products.description: Distribution, supply, and integration of FAA-approved aircraft and military parts, including hydraulic, pneumatic, structural, and electromechanical components, to commercial, regional, and military customers, leveraging logistics and inventory management.

products.name: Specialty Aerospace and Defense Components and Assemblies
products.description: Design, engineering, and manufacture of advanced niche components, complex composite assemblies, thermal insulation systems, expanded foil mesh, and missile hardware for aerospace, defense, and space applications, often as a subcontractor for OEMs and governments.

products.name: Emergency Descent Devices and Parachute Products
products.description: Manufacture and distribution of emergency descent devices, personnel and cargo parachute products, and heavy airdrop platforms for aerospace and defense applications, requiring specialized engineering and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Electro-Optical Simulation, Test, and Laser Products
products.description: Design and manufacture of electro-optical simulation and test equipment, laser rangefinder receivers, and photodetectors for military, aerospace, and medical applications, involving precision engineering and proprietary technology.

products.name: Power Electronics and Avionics Systems
products.description: Design, manufacture, and repair of power supplies, back-up power systems, power conversion products, cockpit displays, wireless cabin control systems, and avionics components for aviation, defense, and industrial markets, requiring high-reliability and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Microwave, RF, and High-Frequency Products
products.description: Design and manufacture of microwave, RF, and high-frequency amplifiers, transmitters, receivers, integrated assemblies, and related components for satellites, spacecraft, electronic warfare, and communications systems, serving commercial and defense markets.

products.name: Electromagnetic and Radio-Frequency Interference Shielding Products
products.description: Design and manufacture of EMI/RFI shielding and suppression filters, including patented circuit board and gasket-type shielding, for aerospace, defense, medical, and electronics industries, requiring specialized materials and engineering.

products.name: High Voltage and Power Conversion Products
products.description: Design and manufacture of high voltage interconnection devices, cable assemblies, energy generators, and power conversion products for medical, industrial, aerospace, and defense applications, involving advanced materials and safety standards.

products.name: Underwater and Emergency Locator Beacons
products.description: Design and manufacture of underwater locator beacons and emergency locator transmission beacons for aircraft and marine applications, meeting stringent regulatory and safety requirements for aviation and defense customers.

products.name: Memory Products and Specialty Semiconductors
products.description: Design, manufacture, and marketing of high-reliability memory products, stacked memory, specialty semiconductors, and processors for satellites, spacecraft, military, and medical equipment, requiring advanced microelectronics manufacturing.

products.name: Harsh Environment Connectivity and Cable Products
products.description: Design and manufacture of high performance, high reliability connectors, interconnect products, and custom molded cable assemblies for aviation, defense, industrial, and medical equipment, requiring robust engineering for demanding environments.

products.name: Technical Surveillance Countermeasures Equipment
products.description: Design and manufacture of equipment to detect devices used for espionage and information theft, serving government, law enforcement, and corporate security markets, involving specialized electronics and security expertise.

products.name: Radiation Assurance Services and Products
products.description: Provision of radiation assurance services and products for testing and simulating radiation effects on electronic components and materials, primarily for aerospace, defense, and high-reliability applications.

products.name: Monoclonal Antibody Therapeutics for Inflammatory and Immunology (I&I) Diseases
products.description: Development and commercialization of novel monoclonal antibody (mAb) therapeutics, primarily targeting validated cytokine pathways (IL-23p19 and IL-17A/F), for the treatment of chronic skin and joint diseases such as psoriasis (PsO), hidradenitis suppurativa (HS), psoriatic arthritis (PsA), and other inflammatory and immunology indications. These biologics are engineered for high affinity, extended half-life, and subcutaneous administration, aiming for infrequent dosing and improved efficacy over existing therapies. Products are manufactured via advanced antibody engineering and are delivered as injectable biologic drugs.

products.name: Combination Monoclonal Antibody Regimens for I&I Diseases
products.description: Development of sequential or combination regimens using proprietary monoclonal antibodies (e.g., ORKA-021, a sequential regimen of ORKA-002 followed by ORKA-001) to leverage the complementary mechanisms of IL-17 and IL-23 inhibition, aiming to provide rapid onset and durable maintenance of disease control in patients with chronic inflammatory and immunology diseases. These regimens are delivered as injectable biologic therapies and may be tailored for specific patient subgroups.

products.name: Pipeline Monoclonal Antibody Therapeutics for Undisclosed I&I Pathways
products.description: Research and development of additional monoclonal antibody therapeutics targeting undisclosed pathways for potential expansion into new inflammatory and immunology indications, particularly in inflammatory dermatology. These are preclinical or early-stage assets intended to broaden the company’s portfolio beyond current lead programs.

products.name: Mineral Exploration and Evaluation Services
products.description: The company acquires, explores, and evaluates mineral properties, primarily gold and silver, in the United States. This involves geological surveys, drilling, and resource estimation, but does not yet include mining or production. Services are delivered through in-person technical labor and regulated field operations.

products.name: Gold and Copper Exploration and Development Services
products.description: The company conducts exploration and development activities focused on discovering and advancing gold and copper mineral deposits, primarily through geological surveys, drilling, and sampling at the Whistler Project in Alaska. These activities require in-person labor, specialized equipment, and compliance with regulatory and environmental standards.

products.name: Semiconductor Assembly Equipment
products.description: Capital equipment designed, developed, manufactured, and sold for assembling semiconductor devices such as integrated circuits, power discretes, LEDs, and sensors. These systems require precision manufacturing, integration of outsourced parts, and are delivered as physical machines to customer facilities.

products.name: Aftermarket Products and Services
products.description: Consumable products (such as dicing blades, capillaries, bonding wedges) and services (maintenance, repair, upgrades) provided for both K&S and peer companies’ semiconductor assembly equipment. These are manufactured in-house or outsourced and delivered as physical goods and on-site services.

products.name: Advanced Packaging Solutions
products.description: Advanced packaging equipment and solutions for 2.5D and 3D integrated circuits, chiplets, and system-in-package (SiP) applications. These are highly specialized machines and processes for next-generation semiconductor packaging, requiring advanced manufacturing and process know-how.

products.name: Precision Dispensing Solutions
products.description: Advanced dispensing equipment (e.g., ACELON™) for precision material placement in semiconductor, SMT, and automotive assembly applications. These are physical machines manufactured and assembled in-house, designed for high-accuracy, high-volume production environments.

products.name: New Recreational Boat Sales
products.description: Sale of new recreational boats, including pleasure boats, fishing boats, luxury yachts, pontoon boats, ski boats, and jet boats, sourced from both internal manufacturing and third-party brands, delivered through physical retail dealerships and digital platforms.

products.name: Used Boat Sales
products.description: Sale of used boats, including trade-ins and previously owned models, offered at retail locations, marinas, and online, with inventory sourced primarily from customer trade-ins and maintained through service programs.

products.name: Marine Engines, Equipment, Parts, and Accessories Sales
products.description: Sale of marine engines, propellers, and a broad variety of boating parts and accessories, including electronics, dock products, water sport equipment, and branded merchandise, through retail locations, offsite venues, and catalogs.

products.name: Maintenance and Repair Services
products.description: Provision of professional maintenance and repair services for boats and yachts, including warranty and non-warranty work, performed by manufacturer-trained technicians at retail locations, stand-alone facilities, and via mobile service units.

products.name: Boat and Yacht Storage and Marina Services
products.description: Offering of in-water slip storage, land storage, and marina accommodations for boats and yachts, including operation and management of luxury marinas worldwide, providing year-round berthing and related amenities.

products.name: Boat and Yacht Brokerage Services
products.description: Brokerage of boats and yachts, including superyachts, through licensed brokers, digital listings, and co-brokerage arrangements, facilitating sales for third-party owners and earning commissions.

products.name: Yacht and Boat Charter Services
products.description: Chartering of power yachts, catamarans, and superyachts to vacation customers, including management of charter fleets and facilitation of third-party yacht charters in destinations such as the British Virgin Islands and globally.

products.name: Finance and Insurance (F&I) Products
products.description: Provision and arrangement of boat and yacht financing, extended service contracts, and insurance products (property, casualty, and specialty coverages) for new and used boat purchases, delivered through retail locations and subsidiaries.

products.name: Boat and Yacht Manufacturing
products.description: Manufacturing of sport yachts, luxury dayboats, and customized powerboats under owned brands (Cruisers Yachts, Aviara, Intrepid Powerboats), with sales through company dealerships and independent dealers, involving physical production facilities and skilled labor.

products.name: Digital Marine Retail and Customer Experience Platforms
products.description: Operation of digital platforms for marine retail (Boatzon) and customer experience solutions (Boatyard), enabling online boat sales, service scheduling, and enhanced customer engagement in the marine industry.

products.name: Crude Oil and Natural Gas Production
products.description: Exploration, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas from global reserves, involving drilling, extraction, and transportation via pipelines and marine vessels. Requires significant physical infrastructure, technical expertise, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Production and Sales
products.description: Processing, liquefaction, transportation, and regasification of natural gas into LNG for global export, utilizing large-scale LNG plants and specialized shipping infrastructure.

products.name: Refined Petroleum Products
products.description: Refining crude oil into petroleum products such as gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, and fuel oil, distributed through a global network of refineries and marketed via branded service stations and commercial channels.

products.name: Renewable Fuels
products.description: Development, production, and sale of renewable fuels including renewable diesel, biodiesel, renewable natural gas (RNG), and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), using biofuel refineries and anaerobic digesters for RNG.

products.name: Lubricants and Additives
products.description: Manufacture and marketing of lubricants, base oils, and performance additives for fuels and lubricating oils, produced in specialized blending and manufacturing facilities and sold globally under multiple brands.

products.name: Commodity Petrochemicals and Plastics
products.description: Production and sale of commodity petrochemicals (olefins, polyolefins, aromatics) and plastics for industrial uses, through joint ventures and manufacturing plants worldwide.

products.name: Carbon Capture and Storage Services
products.description: Provision of carbon dioxide capture, transportation, and underground storage services, leveraging dedicated infrastructure and partnerships to support emissions management for industrial customers.

products.name: Hydrogen and Emerging Energy Solutions
products.description: Development and sale of hydrogen and related energy solutions, including hydrogen production, storage, and supply for industrial and transportation applications, as well as investments in geothermal and lithium for energy storage.

products.name: Intelligent CX Platform
products.description: A cloud-native, AI-powered software platform for enterprise contact centers, providing omni-channel customer engagement, interaction routing, automation, analytics, and integrations with enterprise applications. Delivered as SaaS, it enables organizations to manage customer interactions across voice, chat, email, web, social media, and mobile channels.

products.name: Genius AI Suite
products.description: A portfolio of AI solutions embedded in the CX Platform, including Generative AI-powered virtual agents, agent assistance, workflow automation, call summarization, sentiment analysis, and business insights. Delivered digitally via the cloud, these solutions automate and enhance customer and agent experiences.

products.name: Global Voice & Telecommunications Services
products.description: Cloud-based voice and telephony services integrated with the CX Platform, providing inbound and outbound voice connectivity, call routing, number management, and compliance across multiple geographies. Delivered via a global, redundant network infrastructure.

products.name: Workforce Engagement Management (WEM) Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based applications for workforce management, quality management, performance analytics, and agent/supervisor desktops, enabling contact centers to optimize agent productivity and engagement. Delivered as part of the CX Platform or via integrations.

products.name: Professional Services for Implementation and Optimization
products.description: Consulting and technical services to assist customers in implementing, configuring, integrating, and optimizing the CX Platform and AI solutions, including custom development, AI consulting, and training. Delivered by Five9 or certified partners.

products.name: Long-Duration Iron Flow Battery Energy Storage Systems
products.description: ESS designs, manufactures, and sells long-duration energy storage systems based on proprietary iron flow battery technology. These systems are physically manufactured using earth-abundant materials and are delivered as fully configurable solutions (such as the Energy Base) or as core power trains for on-site assembly, serving grid-scale, commercial, and industrial applications.

products.name: Warranty and Maintenance Services for Deployed Energy Storage Systems
products.description: ESS provides ongoing warranty and maintenance services for its previously sold energy storage products (such as the Energy Warehouse and Energy Center), ensuring continued operation and support for systems under contract in the field. These services are delivered through in-person technical support and field service operations.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides secured loans to commercial enterprises, including business, industrial, agricultural, construction, inventory, and real estate loans. These are delivered through in-person banking services and require financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers direct and indirect loans to consumers and purchasers of residential and real property, including residential mortgages and consumer loans. Delivered via branch network and digital channels, requiring financial capital and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provides a variety of deposit accounts including time, savings, demand deposits, and certificates of deposit, as well as safe deposit services. Delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital banking platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Trust and Wealth Management Services
products.description: Provides trust and wealth management services to customers, involving in-person advisory and fiduciary services delivered through specialized offices and requiring licensed professionals and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Insurance Agency Services
products.description: Offers independent insurance agency services through ChoiceOne Insurance Agencies, Inc., providing insurance products to external customers. Delivered via licensed agents and regulated by state insurance authorities.

products.name: Fintech Product Licensing
products.description: Licenses a fintech product to third party banks and bank holding companies through its subsidiary 109 Technologies, LLC. This is a digital product delivered via software licensing agreements.

products.name: Real Estate Ownership and Leasing
products.description: Acquisition, ownership, renovation, and leasing of commercial and multifamily real estate properties, primarily office buildings and apartment complexes, through direct ownership or majority interests in property-owning entities. Properties are physically acquired, managed, and leased to tenants, requiring significant capital investment and ongoing property management.

products.name: Real Estate Development
products.description: Development and redevelopment of real estate properties, including ground-up construction and value-add renovations, to create new or improved residential and commercial assets. This involves physical construction, entitlement processes, and project management, often financed through a combination of equity and debt.

products.name: Real Estate-Related Securities Investment
products.description: Investment in illiquid or non-traded debt and equity securities issued by U.S. companies that own commercial real estate, including non-traded REITs, small-cap REITs, and real estate limited partnerships. These investments are financial in nature and typically involve purchasing securities at a discount to net asset value.

products.name: Preferred and Common Stock Offerings
products.description: Issuance and sale of the company's own common and preferred stock (Series A, B, and C), including public offerings, at-the-market offerings, and private placements, to raise capital from external investors. This is a financial product delivered through securities markets and regulated offerings.

products.name: Ridesharing Marketplace
products.description: A technology-driven platform connecting riders with drivers for on-demand transportation, including standard rideshare, taxis, private hire vehicles, executive chauffeur services, and car sharing, delivered via the Lyft App and partner apps globally.

products.name: Shared Bikes and Scooters
products.description: A network of shared bikes and scooters available for short-term rental in various cities, physically deployed and managed by Lyft, accessible through the Lyft App for first-mile/last-mile and short-distance trips.

products.name: Express Drive Vehicle Rentals
products.description: A vehicle rental program for drivers who wish to provide ridesharing services but do not own a qualifying vehicle, operated through partnerships and subsidiaries, with vehicles physically provided for driver use.

products.name: Lyft Business Transportation Solutions
products.description: A suite of transportation management solutions for organizations, enabling them to design, manage, and pay for ground transportation programs for employees or clients, delivered via the Lyft Platform and apps.

products.name: Bike and Scooter Equipment Sales and Software Licensing
products.description: Sales of bikes, bike station hardware, and related software, as well as licensing and data access agreements, primarily to external partners and municipalities for operating shared mobility networks.

products.name: Advertising Services
products.description: Provision of advertising services to third parties, leveraging the Lyft Platform and apps to deliver digital and in-vehicle advertising to riders and drivers.

products.name: Terminal Sterilization Services
products.description: Outsourced sterilization of medical devices, pharmaceuticals, food, and advanced materials using gamma irradiation, ethylene oxide (EO) processing, E-beam, X-ray, and NO2-based technologies. Delivered via a global network of specialized facilities requiring significant capital, regulatory compliance, and technical expertise.

products.name: Microbial Reduction and Remediation Services for Food and Agricultural Products
products.description: Microbial reduction and remediation services for food and agricultural products, using irradiation and related technologies to reduce, but not eliminate, viable organisms. Delivered through specialized facilities and processes tailored to food safety requirements.

products.name: Advanced Radiation Processing Services for Industrial Materials
products.description: Radiation processing services for industrial and commercial materials (e.g., semiconductors, polymers, gemstones) using ionizing radiation to modify material properties. Delivered via specialized irradiation facilities and equipment.

products.name: Cobalt-60 (Co-60) Supply for Sterilization and Oncology
products.description: Production, processing, and global distribution of Co-60 radioactive sources for use in gamma sterilization of medical, pharmaceutical, food, and industrial products, as well as for oncology applications (e.g., Gamma Knife radiosurgery). Involves nuclear reactor partnerships, regulatory logistics, and specialized container transport.

products.name: Gamma Irradiation Systems Design, Installation, and Maintenance
products.description: Design, installation, and maintenance of gamma irradiation systems (infrastructure housing Co-60 sources) for sterilization and warehousing facilities. Includes radiation shielding, conveyors, and control systems, delivered with technical support and regulatory expertise.

products.name: Spent Co-60 Source Return and Recycling Services
products.description: For-fee return and recycling services for depleted Co-60 sources, extending the useful life of radioactive material for sterilization and medical applications. Involves logistics, regulatory compliance, and technical processing.

products.name: Microbiological and Analytical Chemistry Lab Testing Services
products.description: Outsourced laboratory testing services for medical device and pharmaceutical companies, including microbiology, biocompatibility, toxicology, sterilization validation, packaging validation, and quality control. Delivered via specialized labs with regulatory and scientific expertise.

products.name: Regulatory and Technical Advisory Services for Healthcare Products
products.description: Expert advisory and consulting services for medical device and pharmaceutical companies, including regulatory compliance, study design, risk assessment, and technical troubleshooting. Delivered by scientific and regulatory experts, often bundled with lab testing.

products.name: Recyclable Composite Matting Rental and Services
products.description: Rental of recyclable composite matting systems, including associated services such as planning, logistics, site construction, and site restoration, primarily delivered through physical deployment and in-person labor to temporary worksites.

products.name: Recyclable Composite Matting Product Sales
products.description: Manufacture and sale of recyclable composite mats, produced using proprietary technology and materials such as high density polyethylene, delivered as physical products to customers globally, especially in the power transmission sector.

products.name: Everpure Platform (Unified Storage and Data Management)
products.description: An integrated, all-flash storage and data management platform that virtualizes and manages data across on-premises, hybrid, public cloud, and edge environments, delivered as a service with built-in automation, unified control, and continuous modernization. Requires physical hardware manufacturing, proprietary software, and cloud infrastructure.

products.name: FlashArray All-Flash Storage Systems
products.description: A family of all-flash storage arrays (including FlashArray//ST, //XL, //X, //C, //E, //RC20) designed for high-performance, mission-critical, and cost-sensitive workloads, supporting block, file, and object storage protocols. Requires proprietary hardware and software integration, manufactured and shipped to customers.

products.name: FlashBlade Scale-Out Storage Systems
products.description: All-flash, scale-out storage systems (including FlashBlade//S, //E, //EXA) optimized for unstructured data, AI, analytics, and high-performance computing workloads, supporting file and object protocols. Built with proprietary hardware and software, manufactured and delivered to customers.

products.name: Everpure Cloud Services
products.description: Enterprise-grade, software-delivered virtual block storage arrays and data management services for public cloud environments (AWS, Azure), enabling hybrid and multi-cloud workflows without dedicated hardware. Delivered digitally via cloud infrastructure.

products.name: Storage-as-a-Service Subscriptions (Evergreen//One, Evergreen//Flex)
products.description: Subscription-based storage services providing on-premises and cloud storage with guaranteed SLAs, flexible consumption, and non-disruptive upgrades. Delivered via a combination of shipped hardware and managed services, aligning with cloud and SaaS models.

products.name: Portworx Kubernetes Data Management
products.description: A software platform for enterprise-grade Kubernetes/container storage, backup, disaster recovery, and data portability across on-premises, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments. Delivered as software, integrates with Everpure and third-party storage.

products.name: Integrated Data Management and Governance Tools
products.description: Integrated data management, governance, and intelligence tools (including forthcoming 1touch acquisition) for data discovery, classification, policy enforcement, lifecycle management, and AI-readiness, embedded within the Everpure Platform. Delivered as software and cloud services.

products.name: Human Prescription Pharmaceuticals
products.description: Therapeutic and preventive agents for the treatment of human disorders, generally sold by prescription and manufactured through chemical synthesis or biologic processes. Delivered primarily to drug wholesalers, retailers, hospitals, and managed health care providers.

products.name: Human Vaccines
products.description: Preventive vaccines for pediatric, adolescent, and adult populations, manufactured using biologic processes and delivered to physicians, wholesalers, distributors, and government entities.

products.name: Animal Health Pharmaceuticals and Vaccines
products.description: Veterinary pharmaceutical and vaccine products for the prevention, treatment, and control of disease in livestock and companion animals, manufactured and marketed globally to veterinarians, distributors, animal producers, farmers, and pet owners.

products.name: Animal Health Digital Identification, Traceability, and Monitoring Solutions
products.description: Digitally connected products and services for animal identification, traceability, and health monitoring, delivered to livestock producers and pet owners, leveraging digital and IoT technologies.

products.name: Third-Party Manufacturing Services
products.description: Contract manufacturing services for third-party pharmaceutical and vaccine companies, utilizing Merck's manufacturing infrastructure and expertise.

products.name: Oncolytic Virus Therapeutics (VCN-01 and VCN-X Platform)
products.description: A pipeline of engineered oncolytic adenoviruses, including VCN-01 and next-generation VCN-X viruses, designed for intravenous, intratumoral, or intravitreal administration to selectively replicate in tumor cells, degrade tumor stroma, and stimulate anti-tumor immune responses. These biologics are manufactured using standard cell culture and bioreactor processes and are delivered as sterile liquid concentrates for infusion or injection.

products.name: Gastrointestinal Microbiome Therapeutics (SYN-004, ribaxamase)
products.description: An oral biologic capsule therapy designed to degrade certain intravenous beta-lactam antibiotics in the GI tract, preserving the gut microbiome and preventing infections such as Clostridioides difficile and vancomycin-resistant Enterococci, as well as reducing acute graft-versus-host disease in transplant recipients. Manufactured via recombinant processes and delivered as oral capsules.

products.name: Oral Intestinal Alkaline Phosphatase Therapeutics (SYN-020)
products.description: A recombinant, orally administered enzyme therapy (intestinal alkaline phosphatase) produced under cGMP conditions, intended to treat GI and systemic diseases by reducing inflammation, tightening the gut barrier, and promoting a healthy microbiome. Commercialization and further development are now licensed to Rasayana Therapeutics.

products.name: Commercial and Personal Banking Services
products.description: Provides a full range of banking services including accepting time and demand deposits, issuing letters of credit, renting safe deposit boxes, and providing funds transfer services. Delivered through physical branches and digital channels, regulated and insured by the FDIC.

products.name: Lending Services
products.description: Offers secured and unsecured loans to corporations and individuals, including commercial, construction, mortgage, personal loans, lines of credit, revolving lines of credit, term loans, and asset-based financing. Requires financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Trust and Wealth Management Services
products.description: Provides trust administration, estate execution, employee benefit trust management, investment agency, and depository services for securities. Delivered by specialized personnel and regulated entities, often involving fiduciary responsibility and asset management.

products.name: Cash Management Services
products.description: Offers cash management solutions to corporate and individual customers, including payment processing and liquidity management. Delivered through digital and in-person channels, requiring secure and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Brokerage and Insurance Services
products.description: Provides full-service brokerage and insurance products to customers, involving the sale of securities and insurance policies through licensed representatives.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Provides loans secured by multifamily residential, non-owner occupied commercial real estate, land, and construction projects. Loans are physically originated, underwritten, and serviced, requiring in-person expertise and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Offers term loans and revolving lines of credit to small to moderate-sized businesses, professional firms, and municipal agencies, often secured by business assets. Requires financial capital, in-person underwriting, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Provides mortgage loans for single-family and multifamily residential properties, including non-conforming jumbo loans. Loans are originated, underwritten, and serviced in-house, requiring physical documentation and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers personal installment loans, home equity lines of credit, and other consumer-related credit products to individuals. Delivered through physical and digital channels, requiring underwriting and compliance with consumer protection laws.

products.name: Small Business and Government-Guaranteed Lending
products.description: Provides SBA and USDA loans and small balance portfolio loans to small businesses, following government program guidelines. Requires specialized underwriting, regulatory compliance, and in-person relationship management.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Offers a range of deposit accounts including personal and business checking, savings, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit. Delivered via physical branches and digital platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure and technology.

products.name: Treasury Management Services
products.description: Provides businesses with cash management solutions such as bill pay, ACH, wire origination, account reconciliation, remote deposit capture, and merchant processing. Delivered through digital and in-person channels, requiring technology and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: Provides online and mobile banking platforms for consumers and businesses, enabling account management, transfers, bill pay, and digital account opening. Delivered digitally, requiring significant technology infrastructure and cybersecurity.

products.name: Specialty Deposit Services
products.description: Offers specialized deposit solutions for complex commercial clients and fiduciaries, including escrow, title, 1031 exchange, contractor retention, and property management accounts. Requires legal expertise and tailored servicing.

products.name: Trust Services
products.description: Provides trust administration and asset management services, including management of trust assets for individuals and organizations. Requires fiduciary expertise, regulatory licensing, and in-person relationship management.

products.name: Investment Advisory and Wealth Management Services
products.description: Offers fee-based investment advisory and wealth management services, including portfolio management, estate and retirement planning, primarily for high net-worth individuals and organizations. Delivered by licensed advisors, requiring financial expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Casegoods Furniture
products.description: Wooden and metal furniture including home entertainment, home office, accent, dining, and bedroom furniture, designed, marketed, and imported primarily for residential use. Products are sourced from foreign manufacturers and distributed through various retail channels.

products.name: Upholstered Furniture
products.description: Imported and domestically manufactured leather and fabric-upholstered furniture, including sofas, sectionals, recliners, chairs, and accent pieces, targeted at upper-medium and premium price points for residential and contract markets. Includes both motion and stationary seating.

products.name: Outdoor Furniture
products.description: Designer and manufacturer of comfortable, stylish, and high-quality outdoor furniture, produced domestically and targeted at residential customers. Products are made to order and shipped after production.

products.name: Hospitality and Contract Furniture
products.description: Custom-designed and manufactured furnishings, including casegoods and upholstered seating, supplied to upscale hotels, senior living, and assisted living facilities. Products are highly customized and built to order for commercial clients.

products.name: Lighting, Accessories, and Home Décor
products.description: A variety of lighting, accessories, and home décor products, including one-of-a-kind designs, marketed and sold under the BOBO Intriguing Objects brand. Products are sourced and distributed to residential customers.
